test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: According to National Multidimensional Poverty Index 2023 (A Progress Review), what is the percentage of the total population who are multidimensionally poor (Headcount Ratio) in Bihar state?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**0.3376**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) 2023** is a significant report that measures poverty using a multidimensional approach, considering various factors such as education, health, and living standards.
 
• According to this report, the **Headcount Ratio** represents the proportion of the population that is classified as multidimensionally poor.
 
• For the state of **Bihar**, the Headcount Ratio is **0.3376**, meaning approximately 33.76% of the population in Bihar is multidimensionally poor.
 
• Bihar is one of the states in India with the highest levels of poverty, as highlighted in the report, despite recent efforts to improve socio-economic conditions.
 
• The **MPI** is a globally recognized measure developed by the **United Nations Development Programme (UNDP)** and the **Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI)**.
 
• This index highlights the need for targeted interventions to address poverty in Bihar, focusing on improving access to education, healthcare, and basic amenities.
 
• The multidimensional approach provides a more comprehensive understanding of poverty compared to traditional income-based measures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About the National Multidimensional Poverty Index**__

 __
 
• The MPI is based on three main dimensions: **health, education, and standard of living**.
 
• Each dimension is further broken down into indicators such as **child mortality, years of schooling, nutrition, sanitation, and access to clean drinking water**.
 
• It helps policymakers prioritize and design interventions targeting specific dimensions of poverty.
 
• The MPI aligns with the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**, particularly Goal 1: **No Poverty**.
 
 
 
• **Explanation of Incorrect Options**__
 
 
• The other options such as **0.3612, 0.4598, and 0.4054** are incorrect as they do not match the officially reported Headcount Ratio for Bihar in the **2023 National MPI Report**.
 
• The correct value, **0.3376**, has been derived from comprehensive data analysis conducted by the report's authors.
